prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: square Ravenpost companion application icon, matching a coordinated set of WoW addon icons.
Input images: Image 1 (WoWLocker lockbox) and Image 2 (Hearthtale journal) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Create a new original subject, not a collage of their objects.
Primary request: a raven messenger carrying a sealed parchment letter, in exactly the same painted fantasy game inventory-icon visual family as the two references.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed opaque deep inky navy square background with subtle energetic painterly blue brushwork and vignette, no outer frame or rounded app tile.
Subject: one handsome, unmistakable raven in three-quarter view, turned slightly to the viewer's left, with a sturdy curved black beak and one sharp amber eye. Its wings are partially spread upward and outward to form a bold, compact silhouette behind a large cream parchment envelope gripped gently in its two talons. The raven is a convincing bird with coherent anatomy. The envelope occupies the lower center of the image and has a crisp triangular flap and a prominent round deep-red wax seal embossed with a small simple gold four-point star. No writing. The raven's expressive head, broad layered wings, and sealed letter must read immediately at 64px. Ravenpost carries saved journals and character records between WoW addons and their websites, so this is a purposeful courier, dignified and approachable.
Style/medium: hand-painted fantasy inventory icon, chunky stylized forms, faceted brush-stroke highlights, rich tactile parchment and feather textures, strong bold contours, vivid jewel tones and confident warm gold highlights. Match the finish, contrast and saturation of the supplied WoWLocker and Hearthtale assets. Avoid realistic photography, smooth plastic 3D and flat vector art.
Color palette and lighting: deep blue-black raven feathers with luminous teal-blue edge highlights separating them from navy background; warm ivory-gold parchment; saturated crimson wax seal with warm gilded highlights; a gentle cool magical glow behind the raven balanced by golden light reflected off the letter. Raven remains predominantly dark, never a blue parrot.
Composition: centered tight icon composition, raven and letter together fill about 85% of square with a clear margin on every edge. Entire subject and wing tips visible. One bird, one envelope, few large readable shapes; no landscape, books, chest, extra letters or small decorative props. Raven's head in upper center, envelope below, balanced compact silhouette.
Constraints: no text, lettering, wordmark, watermark, frame, UI or badge. Opaque background.
